roleRights.lineageHint: From the standard roles to this one: each role lists the capabilities it adds; this role lists all it holds.
roleRights.accessHint: Choose a column: every role that reads, writes, sees it masked or has a row rule on it.
roleRights.accessNone: No role you can see reads or writes this column.
roleRights.accessUnsaved: Who can read each column is shown once the table is saved.
roleRights.dataEmpty: This role reaches no table you can read.
roleRights.dataHint: Every table the role reaches, its domains and the public columns of others; open one for its columns.
